args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Items:
- Travel documents (ID, passport if needed, flight confirmations, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and extra batteries/memory cards
- Medications and first aid kit
- Travel insurance information

Clothing:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Light, breathable clothing (t-shirts, shorts, sundresses)
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Water shoes or reef walkers for snorkeling
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Hat with brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

Beach Day (Waikiki Beach - June 11):
- Beach towel
- Beach bag
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkel gear (or plan to rent)

Snorkeling at Hanauma Bay (June 12):
- Rash guard or UV protective shirt
- Underwater camera
- Reusable water bottle

Hiking at Diamond Head (June 13):
- Sturdy hiking shoes
- Hiking socks
- Backpack with water and snacks
- Sunscreen (reef-safe)
- Insect repellent

Visit to Pearl Harbor (June 14):
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Light layers (some areas may be air-conditioned)

North Shore Road Trip (June 15):
- Car adapter for charging devices
- Cooler for drinks and snacks
- Beach gear for potential stops

Luau Experience (June 16):
- Hawaiian shirt or floral dress (optional but fun)
- Light jacket for evening

Hotel Spa Day (June 17):
- Spa attire if required
- Book or e-reader for relaxation

Kayaking at Kailua Beach (June 18):
- Quick-dry clothing
- Waterproof bag for valuables
- Water shoes

Shopping at Ala Moana Center (June 19):
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Reusable shopping bags

General Items:
- Reef-safe sunscreen (minimum SPF 30)
- Aloe vera gel for sunburn relief
- Lip balm with SPF
- Moisturizer
- Toiletries
- Hair ties and brush
- Travel-sized laundry detergent
- Reusable water bottle
- Snacks for day trips
- Small backpack or day bag for excursions

Electronics:
- Universal power adapter if needed
- Portable power bank
- Headphones
- E-reader or books

Don't Forget:
- Return flight details
- Emergency contact information
- Hotel check-out procedures
